proposals.title: Persist measured usage on pipeline terminal paths (failed / budget_exceeded / cancelled; optional startup-interrupted coverage)

rootCause.why: gate-fail branch marks the run terminal without cost_usd/prompt_tokens/completion_tokens
catch branch (failed / budget_exceeded / cancelled / timeout) calls updateRun without usage fields
review/audit and adhoc gate-fail branches use markTerminal without usage fields
markTerminal, the shared terminal writer, never aggregates usage
success finalize is the only writer of cost_usd/tokens, proving the asymmetry

fix.summary: Make the single terminal writer copy usageTotals(runId) into the run row; route the catch branch through it.

edits.before: import { createRunRow, getRun, updateRun, emitEvent } from './recorder.js';
edits.after: import { createRunRow, getRun, updateRun, emitEvent, usageTotals } from './recorder.js';

edits.before: updateRun(runId, { status, phase: 'done', finished_at: now(), error_code: code, error_message: redactString(message).slice(0, 1000) });

edits.why: covers a crashed/interrupted active run that already recorded usage; no such row exists in this DB, so it is not needed for the 7 measured cases

notes: markTerminal's signature and all three gate-fail call sites are unchanged.
The catch branch already imports markTerminal (run.ts:18); only the write call changes.
usageTotals is already the honest aggregator: NULL when no usage rows, NULL for all three fields when any row has source='unknown' (recorder.ts:355-378).
Do not fabricate 0 for a zero-call completed run; that is a separate product decision (peer W6-L-02).

edgeCases: no usage rows -> cost/tokens stay NULL (honest unknown)
any source='unknown' row -> all three fields NULL (existing usageTotals contract)
timeout with an aborted in-flight call -> only completed calls are summed, same as traces
double terminal write -> last write wins; all writers converge on the same totals
idempotent create replay (manager.ts:91-96) returns the same run id and never re-enters markTerminal
historical 7 runs remain NULL; no backfill in this fix

tests.name: markTerminal persists provider usage sums and honest nulls
asserts: run with two provider usage rows -> runs.cost_usd/prompt_tokens/completion_tokens equal the sums
run with an unknown-source usage row -> all three fields NULL
run with no usage rows -> all three fields NULL
gate-fail path and catch path both produce the same persisted totals

tests.name: failed run snapshot exposes measured cost
asserts: GET /api/runs/:id/snapshot run.costUsd equals SUM(usage.cost_usd) for a failed fixture
sum(runs.cost_usd) equals SUM(usage.cost_usd) across runs that have usage (removes the stats contradiction)

rollback.schemaOrDataImpact: none; rows written by the fixed code keep their values, old rows stay NULL

proposals.title: Show the persisted ledger once the run is terminal (fix the live-buffer precedence in the Events tab)
proposals.confidence: high on the code path, medium on live UX frequency

rootCause.why: visibleEvents prefers any non-empty live array over the fetched persisted ledger
events is reset only on runId change and is not cleared when the stream closes at terminal
persisted events are fetched exactly when terminal (and then ignored if live rows exist)
the heading/description already claim the persisted ledger on terminal, so the UI lies about its own source

fix.summary: Extract a pure selector and use it: terminal -> persisted ledger (or empty), non-terminal -> live buffer.

edits.after:
import { useApiResource, useRunStream } from '../hooks/useApi';
import { selectVisibleRunEvents } from '@shared/run-events';

alternativesConsidered: clearing events when terminal: loses the live rows if the persisted fetch fails and still needs the selector to render
merging by seq: RunStreamEvent has no seq (web/src/api-types.ts:102-106), so this would change the wire type; unnecessary for truthfulness

edgeCases: terminal + persisted still loading -> EventsTab spinner (persistedEvents.loading)
terminal + persisted error -> ErrorPanel (no silent fallback to a mislabeled live list)
terminal + zero persisted rows -> honest empty state with snapshot lastEventId
non-terminal -> unchanged live buffer (bounded to 100)
runId change -> events reset as today; persisted fetch keyed by runId+terminal
live watch to terminal -> persisted ledger replaces the incomplete live buffer

tests.name: selectVisibleRunEvents prefers persisted on terminal
asserts: terminal=true, live non-empty, persisted 108 -> persisted 108
terminal=true, persisted null -> []
terminal=false, live non-empty -> the same live array
terminal=false, persisted non-empty -> live array (persisted is not fetched for live runs)

tests.name: a run page opened live and ended terminal shows the persisted ledger
asserts: route interception returns a running snapshot first, then a failed snapshot and 108 persisted events (HTTP client double, test-only)
Events tab heading is 'Persisted events' and the row count equals the /events count, including run.queued and repair.stalled

rollback.action: revert the selector export, its import and the one-line call site

proposals.title: Make the live event vocabulary match the emitted vocabulary and the persisted payload shape

rootCause.why: STREAM_EVENT_TYPES is missing run.queued, agent.failed, phase.skipped, context.skipped, repair.stalled
one listener per listed type; named SSE frames with other types are never dispatched and onmessage stays empty
the live handler stores the parsed envelope as data while the persisted mapper stores the bare payload
persisted rows map data=row.payload, proving the shape mismatch with live

fix.summary: Add the five emitted names, unwrap the SSE envelope into the same payload shape, and pin the vocabulary with a source contract test.

edits.after: insert 'run.queued' after 'run.started'; 'phase.skipped' after 'phase.completed'; 'agent.failed' after 'agent.started'; 'context.skipped' after 'context.packed'; 'repair.stalled' after 'repair.completed' (keep the existing 27 entries unchanged)

fix.notInScope: emitting the 16 subscribed-but-never-emitted types (step/agent.delta/learning/etc.) or deleting their listeners; separate product decision

edgeCases: raw non-JSON SSE data -> payload stays the raw string (unchanged fallback)
JSON payload without a data field -> payload stays the parsed value, type falls back to event.type as today
heartbeat is an SSE comment (: ping) and is never delivered; the listener remains dead by construction
duplicate/regenerated listeners: adding names is idempotent per effect; source.close() tears them down
terminal replay uses the same handler and now receives the 5 types that exist

tests.name: every emitted event type is subscribed by the client
asserts: regex every emitEvent literal in src/**/*.ts (including the run.cancelled/run.failed ternary)
regex STREAM_EVENT_TYPES in web/src/hooks/useApi.ts
emitted subset of subscribed; failure names the missing type

tests.name: live and persisted events have the same data shape
asserts: a frame data {schema,type,data:{a:1},meta} normalizes to {a:1}
a persisted row payload {a:1} maps to {a:1}

rollback.action: remove the five names, restore the handler lines, delete the contract test

proposals.title: Compute /events truncation from this run's rows, not the global sequence

rootCause.why: start = max(after, current - 500) and truncated = after < start || current - start > events.length mix per-run current with global AUTOINCREMENT seqs
getEvents filters by run_id and seq > after, but the route computes the window boundary outside that query

measuredImpact.currentUiConsumer: web/src/api.ts:327-332 drops the flag, so no current visual falsehood

fix.summary: Fetch one extra row after the cursor; truncation is whether more than the window exists, and return the newest window.
fix.apiChange: none (same response shape; flag semantics corrected)
notes: Do not change getEvents; passing window+1 is the whole windowing change.
after > last -> 0 rows, truncated=false, lastEventId=current (route caller sees no events after its cursor).
Optional follow-up: return {events,truncated} from web/src/api.ts:327-332 and show a truncation notice; out of scope here.

edgeCases: empty run -> 0 rows, truncated=false, lastEventId=0/current
exactly window rows -> truncated=false
window+1 rows -> truncated=true, newest window returned
first run in the DB (seq starting at 1) and later interleaved runs -> same result, no global-seq dependence
after cursor mid-run -> correct forward window and flag
retry: GET is idempotent; no cursor state is mutated server-side
no dropped rows anymore -> no false 'Replay truncated' badge if the UI later consumes it

tests.name: /events reports truncation from this run's rows
asserts: 550-event run -> 500 rows, truncated=true
20-event run whose first seq is > 500 (the production false positive) -> 20 rows, truncated=false
0-event run -> 0 rows, truncated=false
exactly 500 events -> truncated=false; 501 -> truncated=true
after=cursor -> forward window and flag correct

proposals.title: Stop the run detail from reading fields the API never provides (cost cap, check code/time)

rootCause.why: reads snapshot.data.limits.maxCostUsd, but the snapshot route returns no limits key
snapshot response is {run,lastEventId,steps,checks,artifacts,truncated} only
renders check.code and check.durationMs; getChecks/insertCheck never persist or return them
checks table mapper exposes id/status/detail/mandatory/file/line only
checks schema has no code/duration_ms columns; durationMs has no producer anywhere in src/

fix.summary: Add the effective run cap to the snapshot (runBudgetUsd is already imported) and drop the two never-populated check columns.

edits.after: remove the Code and Time column header and cells; keep Check/Status/Mandatory/Detail/File

fix.apiChange: additive limits key only; the UI already expects it
fix.alternativeIfCheckCodeIsRequired: add a migration group 030_checks_code (ALTER TABLE checks ADD COLUMN code TEXT), persist check.code in insertCheck, map it in getChecks, and add a durationMs producer before exposing Time; larger and out of this proposal

edgeCases: snapshot for a run with a per-run cap in settings -> limits.maxCostUsd equals runBudgetUsd(id)
snapshot for a run without a per-run cap -> global MAX_RUN_COST_USD
old runs -> no data migration needed
check.code remains available at write time (verifier.ts:118) even though the UI no longer shows an empty column
no false '—' columns remain

tests.name: snapshot exposes the effective per-run cap
asserts: a run with a run_limit setting returns limits.maxCostUsd == runBudgetUsd(runId)
a run without the setting returns the global cap

tests.name: Checks tab has no permanently empty Code/Time columns
asserts: column headers are exactly Check/Status/Mandatory/Detail/File

rollback.action: revert the limits key and restore the two columns

proposals.title: Give every Checks row a unique key and a way to tell verification passes apart
proposals.status: SUPPORTED (key non-uniqueness); the peer's collapse/warning claim is REFUTED by measurement

rootCause.why: getChecks maps the repeated check_id into id and discards the unique checks.id row id
ChecksTab renders <tr key={check.id}>; 16 rows share 5 ids (abf5), so the React key is not unique

measured.correction: production React suppresses the development duplicate-key warning; no row collapse was observed. The defect is the non-unique key and the inability to distinguish passes, not a broken table.

fix.summary: Key on a unique identity and show the pass identity (createdAt) or group passes in the route.

edits.before: checks table columns do not identify the verification pass
edits.after: optional larger change: add a Pass/Recorded column fed by checks.created_at returned from getChecks; group by id if a summary view is preferred

fix.apiChange: none for the minimal UI key fix; optional additive createdAt if passes are shown

edgeCases: runs with one verification pass -> index-keyed rows are unique
runs with 2-3 passes -> each row keeps its own position and detail; no collision
no check rows -> existing empty state
createdAt is already in the checks table and can be added additively

tests.name: Checks tab renders one row per persisted check row
asserts: DOM row count equals GET /api/runs/:id/checks count for run_abf5 (16)
no two rows are treated as the same key (assert 16 distinct row texts/positions)

rollback.action: revert the key expression / optional column

a >200-artifact run -> badge now names the artifact cap

asserts: when snapshot.truncated is forced in a test fixture, the badge text is 'Artifact list truncated'

notProposed.reason: run_abf5 Running/7 steps is a mid-run capture, not a defect; no fix. Fresh UI matches the API on 3/3 terminal runs and no stream/poll happens on terminal pages.
run.cancelled is already subscribed at web/src/hooks/useApi.ts:76 and emitted at run.ts:885 / manager.ts:186; the brief's 'cancelled' candidate is false.
The Wave-5 stub-scan false positive no longer reproduces (current scanText returns 0 findings on the stored abf5 artifact); the historical ledger row is preserved, not a current defect.

410 SSE reconnect loop is UNVERIFIED at the client half: no run in this DB has a >500-event reconnect gap and paid runs are forbidden. The route half is proven (HTTP 410 JSON) and the client has no status-code access; a fix should be designed with a reproduced loop, not before.
Dead run state machine is peer W6-L-03; no production illegal transition exists. Wiring or deleting the guard is a product decision.
Read from the peer report but not independently probed by this seat; no proposal duplicated here.

a run watched from running to terminal shows the persisted ledger (108 rows for abf5) and the heading is honest
